sc: Farm child, sweating, drooling, pinpoint pupils, wet chest, bradycardia → Organophosphate: atropine until dry
Child drank kerosene → Never induce vomiting (aspiration pneumonitis)
Huge swollen face and neck, dark urine after hair dye → PPD poisoning: secure the airway
f: ABC · decontaminate · activated charcoal 1 g/kg within 1 h (not for iron, alcohol, kerosene, corrosives) · antidote · supportive
Toxic > 60 mg/kg elemental · vomiting, bloody diarrhoea, shock, liver failure · desferrioxamine
SLUDGE + bradycardia, pinpoint pupils · atropine 0.02–0.05 mg/kg, double every 5 min until the chest is dry · pralidoxime
Opioid: naloxone 0.1 mg/kg · benzodiazepine: flumazenil (care) · digoxin: Fab · CO: oxygen
No vomiting, no charcoal, no lavage · kerosene: watch for pneumonitis · PPD (hair dye): airway, then renal failure
trap: Never induce vomiting after kerosene or corrosives · charcoal does not bind iron · atropine end point is a dry chest, not pupil size
